title: AA Academy publication allowlist
description: docs/learn/allowlist.yaml (decision D13): the only skill, steering and CONTEXT.md sections the learn bundle publishes, and the only catalog page sections an agency (partner tier) module may cite; one entry per section, default deny. A change here is reviewed as an access change. Checked by tools/docs/check_learn.py (AA-1104).

ref.description: skill:<name>#anchor, steering:<name>#anchor or context:<repo>#anchor; or doc:<catalog id>#anchor, a catalog page section granted to tier partner (staff read catalog pages without an entry). A whole file or page is never allowlisted.

tier.description: staff: every staff role may read it; partner: agency learners may read it too. A doc: entry is always partner.

reason.description: Why a learner needs this section.
